title: Yellowed Dense Uruguayan Beef Skewers
description: A salty and dense Uruguayan dish featuring mustard seeds, this crowd-pleaser is perfect for any occasion, made without onion or garlic for a unique flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat a tava griddle over medium-high heat to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the beef strips to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated beef strips onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the preheated tava griddle with a small amount of olive oil to prevent sticking.
Place the skewers on the tava griddle and cook for 5 minutes per side, or until the beef reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the beef is cooking, mix the mustard seeds with red wine vinegar and beef broth in a small bowl.
After flipping the skewers, brush the mustard seed mixture onto the cooked side of the beef.
Once the beef is cooked, remove the skewers from the tava griddle and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
